name: Women of Wasteland
author: DeonUrist
summary: Turns a share of Flexa and Sprokka raiders into female Gungirls and Shootas with their own models, textures and voices. Part of what was Apocaraider.
deprecatedReason: Women of Wasteland is included in Wild Wasteland 1.0. Install Wild Wasteland and disable this standalone plugin to avoid duplicate features. Keep existing configuration and data files for migration.
